## Transatlantic Theory Workshop

Co-founder and co-organizer since 2008.

A recurring workshop in game theory and economic theory, bringing together researchers from Paris, Northwestern, Oxford and Bocconi.

## Paris Game Theory Festival

Co-founder and co-organizer since 2025.

The [Paris Game Theory Festival](https://sites.google.com/view/parisgtfestival/) brings together recurring workshops on game theory, information and language.

Editions: [2025](https://sites.google.com/view/parisgtfestival/2025) · [2026](https://sites.google.com/view/parisgtfestival/2026) · [2027 (forthcoming)](https://sites.google.com/view/parisgtfestival/2027)
